theorem.name: residual Omega-closure is a terminating, sound decision procedure
steps: M2-prime: co-component is permanent, so same_component is discharged for every pair inside the merged component at every descendant and cannot be re-blocked
M3: only the five non-component recognizer conditions remain (r_count 1->2, kind==R, F==1, H==0, hub_touch_count<=2)
M4: all six inputs are Omega-computable; the predicate never reads hex_masks
OMEGA-TERM: closure is acyclic, depth <= 720 - popcount(orbit_masks), branching <= 24; memoized DFS terminates
OMEGA-SOUND: a negative result transfers to exact -- no Omega-reachable Target-A exit implies no exact-reachable Target-A exit
theorem.conclusion: family-level closure of F7 and the merged part of F8 reduces to 1795 terminating, sound one-sided Omega-closures
